problem: End-to-end tests in Playwright, Selenium and Cypress break on flaky selectors and timing, which costs engineering time.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription, pricing from 1,000 USD per month

founders.name: Suchit Dubey
founders.background_notes: From YC page. One aggregator names Akshit Khurana as a founder; not on the YC page, omitted.

competitors.name: mabl

technical_complexity.rationale: Self healing browser tests with record and replay are standard automation engineering with some hard ML parts.

defensibility.rationale: Test suites create some lock in but many funded rivals offer similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A search result says Tricentis acquired Testim; many AI testing startups such as Momentic and TestSprite raised seeds in 2024 and 2025.

market_need_then: The product replaces flaky Playwright, Selenium and Cypress tests; dated demand evidence was not found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Short product tagline: ship quality with AI testing

branding.brand_signature: Masked fox mascot after the rename

rebrands.why: Not stated; company site says Narrative is now Zorro. Legal name still Try Narrative, Inc. per footer.

brand_strength.rationale: Generic name shared with several other Narrative companies; rebranded to Zorro, which suggests the original name limited it.

outcome_analysis: Narrative is active and has rebranded as Zorro with named customers such as Nanonets and Commenda, and a stated price from 1,000 USD per month. The name Narrative collided with other companies, and the rebrand points to that. Funding is unverified and the crowded AI testing market shows rising competition.
notes: Aggregators conflict on funding (StartupHub 10M total, Standout 4.5M seed with YC, Rebel Fund, IIA Seed Ventures); unverified, not recorded. The brand_confusion failure factor is an inference from the rebrand and is not stated by the company. Rebrand date not found.
